metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a ZhenTec EEG system with 30 channels arranged in standard 10-05 montage (reference: CPz, ground: FPz) at 500 Hz sampling rate. Participants performed cue-based motor imagery of left and right leg flexion/extension in 5 sessions of 100 trials each (50 trials per class per session), with 4-second trial duration and visual stimulus presentation. No feedback was provided during the offline paradigm.

citation_details.title: Classification of the lower limb motor imagery and execution using high vs. low channel EEG devices
citation_details.author: Parsa Bahramsari, Saeed Behzadipour
citation_details.abstract: Abstract Brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) translate brain signals into commands for external devices, with motor imagery (MI) BCIs decoding imagined movements to aid neurorehabilitation. Although high-channel EEG offers rich data, such systems are bulky and impractical for everyday use. This study assesses whether a low-channel, consumer-grade headset (Muse) can match a clinical-grade system (OpenBCI) in classifying lower limb MI and motor execution (ME). Six healthy volunteers performed left and right knees and ankles MI and ME tasks while EEG was recorded concurrently from both devices. Signals were band-pass filtered (8–30 Hz), segmented into overlapping one second windows, and features were extracted across time, frequency, and time-frequency domains. Feature dimensionality was reduced via mutual information-based minimum redundancy maximum relevance and principal component analysis. citation_details.title: Construction of Chicken Oviduct-specific Leptin Expression Vector and Its Experssion
citation_details.author: Bichun Li
citation_details.abstract: This paper aimed at obtaining a large number of available human leptin protein for experiment research in the principle of bio-reactor.According to the published sequence of human leptin gene in GenBank (accession number is NM000230),we desiged a pair of specific primer to construct the chicken oviduct-specific expression of leptin vector POV3-OB.The recombinant plasmid was injected into the wing vein of tested chickens after being wrapped with PEI.Egg was collected and detected to exam whether the leptin protein is expressed.The gene expression product was analyzed by Western-blot,results showed that leptin proteins expressed specificly.This experiment showed that the recombinant plasmid could express human leptin protein in chicken oviduct.It made the basis for the obtaining of the large amount of protein and research of its biological activity.
